answer: Like mycelium routing nutrients through soil, an agent economy resists Sybil attacks through web-of-trust crystallization. Trust edges forge consensus pathways where proof-of-interaction stakes compound superlinearly: sustaining N clone nodes incurs O(N²) slashing penalties. When adversarial swarms mimic a blossoming plume to dilute governance, their capital vanishes into collective fungal roots before the dawn of finality can validate them.
